notes.title: Story Mode and a new save system
notes.notes:
The current version of the game is challenging.  In fact it's Challenging Mode.
But not everyone wants to search dark places with deadly traps.
If you are interested in the plot and audio experiences, play the new Story Mode!

Attention!
We are also introducing a new save system in this release. All current settings and completed levels will be lost.

notes.title: Improvements for the blind community July 2021
notes.notes:
We received a lot of questions about different languages in the game. Currently RF fully supports English. We have also Polish subtitles but till now no TTS support what made the subtitles useless for the Polish blind community.
This update comes with the solution! Now you can turn on automatic reading of subtitles:

- in Main Menu choose Options
- set Read Texts: On
- set Subtitles: Polish (the lector will read Polskie Napisy)

We will add more languages soon.

Ważne zmiany dla polskiej społeczności niewidomych graczy: można już włączyć czytanie napisów po polsku. Program korzysta z wbudwanego w Windowsa systemu czytania. Wkrótce przedstawimy też instrukcje jak uruchomić popularniejsze głosy jak np. Jacek z Ivony.

Aby uruchomić czytanie napisów:
- w Menu Głównym (Main Menu) wybierz Opcje (Options)
- wybierz Read Texts: On
- English Subtitles zamień na Polskie Napisy - powinieneś usłyszeć głos Jacka wymawiającego opcję po polsku

Thanks!

notes.title: Recordings in Owińska July 2021
notes.notes:
Between June and July we visited Owińska to record the original stuff to the second chapter. 
We found another old abandoned buildings and entered some previously closed areas. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080329/7dd1402fbf9aec740083f7f94ebabadf3199b7ad.jpg[/img]

The story will reveal a lot of information about the experiment by Dr. Drucki, interferring beings, timespace travelling, mysterious unit Reichsokkultekräfte (the occult forces of the Reich), CIA research after WW2 and Mary's adventures in NY during 2010s.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080329/5c64c0ef9c176f8cfd7151669e4d71e3b2bb220b.jpg[/img]
Even lamps have its own sounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080329/d4ff13f803e5e10bb75758d0fa9b601297691be0.jpg[/img]
There are still some dungeons closed for decades.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40080329/fda08fe5fa656fc36f4fd9456c32079ce0e3cc3a.jpg[/img]
Sister Klara fell ill in one night, and we lost contact with her...

notes.title: Music paths in locations 2 and 6
notes.notes: Locations 2 and 6 are problematic for some of you. We added more music paths to help you accomplish these levels.

notes.title: Updates after streams
notes.notes:
After we watched few streams on Twitch, we realized that we need to improve the tutorial. We also added small hints in areas where the players were stuck.

When you play for a first time, it's hard to immediately accomplish all levels. You need some time to learn. We observe the flow from 6-7 location.
